title: Andrew file system
comment: The Andrew File System ( AFS ) is a distributed networked file system which uses a set of trusted servers to present a homogeneous, location-transparent file name space to all the client workstations. It was developed by Carnegie Mellon University as part of the Andrew Project . It is named after Andrew Carnegie and Andrew Mellon . Its primary use is in distributed computing . Contents 1 Features
